'''Lorardia''', or '''Lorardian''', was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[D'Astan sector/Legends|D'Astan sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==History==
Lorardia was one of the [[Mistryl Shadow Guard|Mistryl]] worlds [[Lorardian slaughter|destroyed]] by the [[Cavrilhu Pirates]].

==Appearances==
*''[[Vision of the Future]]'' {{Ab|Vision of the Future (unabridged audiobook)}} {{1stm|in book}}
